text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HasTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Premises:
∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HasTeeth(x)) ::: Some mammals have teeth.
∀x (Platypus(x) → ¬HasTeeth(x)) ::: Platypuses have no teeth.
∀x (Platypus(x) → Mammal(x)) ::: Platypuses are mammals.
∀x (Human(x) → HasTeeth(x)) ::: Humans have teeth.
Conclusion:
∀x (Platypus(x) → (Mammal(x) ∧ ¬HasTeeth(x))) ::: Platypuses are mammals with no teeth.
